# Privacy policy

By using the SalesMail Application, you consent to the collection and storage of the information you provide MySalesMail.com in accordance with this Privacy Statement.

**Sidekick Mobile App**. If you use the SalesMail Sidekick mobile app, our [Mobile App Privacy Policy](https://www.salesmail.com/mobile-app-policy) explains how the app uses your device’s microphone, records conversations, uses AI providers to process recordings, and how long we keep that information. Where the two policies differ, the Mobile App Privacy Policy controls for the app.

## 1\. Collection of personal Information

We only collect information that is essential for basic operation of the service. By posting content using the service you grant us the right and license to use for promotion, modify, publicly display, reproduce, and distribute such content on and through the service, but only for the betterment of the Service. This license does not extend to Customer Data captured or Processed through Sidekick's conversation-recording or transcription features, or to the Personal Data of any individual who has not personally created an Account and posted content through the Service. That data is governed instead by the Data Processing Addendum between SalesMail and the business on whose behalf it was captured. Example of information you may provide: Name, email, & job title: To gain access to the site a user must register for the service providing the minimum information of: name and email.

## 2\. Minors

SalesMail is meant for people of all ages, but it is strongly encouraged that children under the age of 18 obtain permission of a parent or guardian. We do not knowingly seek or collect information from children under the age of 13.

## 3\. How SalesMail uses your information

By allowing SalesMail to collect your personal information you are consenting to the collection, storage, transfer and processing of that information. You grant SalesMail the right and license to use for promotion, modify, publicly display, reproduce, and distribute such content on and through the service, but only for the betterment of the Service. This license, and the rest of this Section 3, does not extend to Customer Data captured or Processed through Sidekick's conversation-recording or transcription features. That data is Processed solely as described in the Data Processing Addendum between SalesMail and the business on whose behalf it was captured, and is not used for advertising, promotion, or public display.

SalesMail may communicate with you for the purpose of updating you on changes in your membership and related products/services. If you do not wish to keep receiving promotional emails you may respond to those promotional emails with “UNSUBSCRIBE” in the body or subject line. SalesMail may show applicable advertisements to you based upon the demographic data you have provided. We do not provide your personal or individual account information to third part advertisers. We do not sell or distribute your personal information to these advertisers without your consent to do so. We may wish to showcase your activity or video to the website’s community. If we would like to highlight one of your contributions, we will attribute it to you and ask for your permission first.

## 4\. Sidekick

Sidekick is SalesMail’s tour coaching app, provided to staff by their employer. When you record a tour, Sidekick collects the recording, its transcript, your notes, visitor details from your organization’s CRM, and your account and device details. Recording starts only after you confirm the visitor agreed. Amazon Transcribe (Amazon Web Services) turns recordings into text, and Anthropic’s Claude analyzes the text to produce coaching, follow-up drafts and answers to your questions. Both providers act as our Sub-Processors under Section 9 of our Data Processing Addendum and process Sidekick data only to provide these features to us. SalesMail does not build or train AI models, and we do not use Sidekick data to train AI models, ours or anyone else’s. We use it only to provide Sidekick to your organization, and we never sell it or use it for advertising. Recordings are deleted from your phone as soon as they upload. On our servers, we keep Sidekick data only while your organization’s agreement with us is in effect and the data is needed to provide Sidekick. We delete it at your organization’s request, or after the agreement ends as DPA Section 14 describes. Deleting a tour in the app hides it but does not erase it. To permanently delete Sidekick data or withdraw consent, contact your organization’s administrator or support@salesmail.com. If you were recorded on a tour, contact the business you visited or support@salesmail.com, and we will help that business respond (DPA Section 12).

## 5\. Information disclosed to third parties

SalesMail will not disclose your personal information to third parties except as outlined in the circumstance below: (a) with your knowledge and consent (b) as outlined in this Privacy Statement (c) as permitted to protect the property, rights, security, safety of SalesMail (d) as required by law or regulating authorities (e) to allow SalesMail to pursue remedies or limit possible damages we may receive (f) to enforce our terms and conditions (g) to prevent fraud and/or cybercrime. We may disclose certain information to third parties to perform certain tasks including the storage, consolidation, analysis, or management of information to communicate with site users. An outside party may be used to assist in processing payments but it is important to note that they are only given access to the information needed to complete their function. Please note that we have no responsibility over the privacy and data collection methods used by third party should you click away and visit their website.

## 6\. Log data

Like many site operators, we collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our site. This log data may include information such as your computer’s internet protocol address, browser type, browser version, the pages of our site that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time you spent on those pages and other statistics. We may use cookies to collect information or for targeted advertising purposes. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do no accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our site.

## 7\. GDPR statement

Location of Data: SalesMail is based in the United States. We provide services globally using computer systems, servers, and databases located in the U.S. When you use our services from outside of the U.S., your information will therefore be transferred to, stored in, and processed in the U.S. Data is collected, stored, used, and shared as set forth in our privacy policies. We could not provide our services or comply with our obligations to you without transferring your personal information to the U.S. We’ll store only the profile information you choose to add and content you upload or submit within the SalesMail database.

We do not use any of your contact information to send commercial or marketing materials without your consent. We may send emails for administration purposes to inform you of major changes within the app. We may collect information about what pages you visit and actions you take on the platform to provide analytics and further improve the end-user experience. We retain the personal information collected from you as long as it’s relevant to our business purposes or until you request that we remove the data by contacting us at [support@salesmail.com](mailto:support@salesmail.com)

## 8\. Contact us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [support@salesmail.com](mailto:support@salesmail.com).

## 9\. Changes

We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to modify or replace these Terms at any time. If a revision is material we will provide at least 30 days notice prior to any new terms taking effect. What constitutes a material change will be determined at our sole discretion. By continuing to access or use our Service after any revisions become effective, you agree to be bound by the revised terms. If you do not agree to the new terms, you are no longer authorized to use the Service.
